paragraphs: My Hobby, by May. I am May, and I am in Teacher Kim's class. My hobby is to make a quiz. I write questions, and my family answers them. I have already made twenty quiz cards. I write each card by hand with a blue pen. I keep them in an empty box that Mom gave me.

Every Sunday evening, we play after dinner. We sit on the floor in the living room. My grandma, my mom, my dad, and Pat play with me. Bill, our green parrot, sits on a chair and says, "Hello!" Then I read a question, and everyone thinks for a minute. No one wins a prize, because we play for fun. Pat is nine, so I make easy questions for him. Mom likes questions about books, and Dad likes questions about sports. After the last card, we eat fruit together.

I got the idea from a quiz channel on TV. My grandma watches it every afternoon. Her favorite show begins at four o'clock. I sit next to her and write the questions that I like. My grandma prefers questions about old songs. She tells me a story about each song. I prefer questions about animals. We do not have the same favorite, but we have the same fun.

Here is one card from my box. The question is, "Which green bird can repeat words?" The answer is, "A parrot." Pat always knows this answer, because Bill talks every day. Another card says, "Which is bigger, a camel or a cat?" Pat shouted, "A camel!" He was right. Last Sunday, Pat got all five questions right. He was so happy that he sang a song for Bill.
Have you ever made a quiz? Who plays with you at home? Tell me in a message, and I will make a card for you!
text.summary: May writes a page for Explorers' Blog about her hobby. Every Sunday evening, she makes quiz cards and plays with her family, and she tells what she likes and with whom she plays.
